_comment: WHICH TILES ALWAYS KEEP THEIR OWN TOP (maintainer 2026-08-27: 'Some on top of-tiles have graphics that looks very very good with its own top texture. Replacing with the base tile sets top doesn't transition as nicely toward the wall.'). The base-tile-set model swaps an x-over-y tile's top for the ground's configured surface; a tile marked here is exempt and always draws the texture it was generated with - HIGHER PRIORITY than the set composition. One entry per tile key (the review manifest's own key): { own_top: true, updated_at }. Absent means the default - the ground's configured top - so this file only ever names the exceptions. Written by the wiki's pair pages; consumed by whatever composes ground tops (the wiki today, the game when it adopts the set model).
